convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load the 'i_Trend' custom indicator, and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh for BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/Close functions and money management logic. Custom indicator and external library must be replicated manually.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: BUY_Close triggered when Ind crosses below Sign; SELL_Close triggered when Ind crosses above Sign

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss, LOT=fixed lots. Default mode is LOT with MM=0.1

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses two-bar comparison: Ind[1]>Sign[1] (previous bar indicator above signal) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (current bar indicator at or below signal) triggers BUY_Open - this is a crossover from the previous bar where the indicator was above and now crossed to at-or-below. The inverse logic applies for SELL_Open. Signal is evaluated only on new bar (NB.IsNewBar) or when Recount is true. The Recount flag resets on successful copy and sets to true on copy failure, providing a retry mechanism. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, used by BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen for trade timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags allow independently enabling/disabling each direction and action.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The i_Trend custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - it combines MA and Bollinger Bands with a custom price type enum. 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/Close functions with 5 margin modes (MMMode enum) - these must be reimplemented, including the signal-time-based order logic. 3) The crossover detection uses previous bar (index 1) vs current bar (index 0) from CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset - note the inverted logic: BUY opens when Ind was above Sign and crossed DOWN to <=, which suggests the i_Trend indicator has an inverted interpretation (indicator below signal = bullish). 4) SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - need to verify if these are raw points or already pip-adjusted for 5-digit brokers. 5) CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be replicated for new-bar detection. 6) LoadHistory() and GlobalVariableDel_() are TradeAlgorithms.mqh utilities.
